responsibility: Declares optrecord_json_writer, the component that turns optinfo records and pass metadata into GCC’s JSON optimization-record format. It exposes APIs for adding records, popping nested scopes, converting locations/profile counts/passes/optinfo objects to JSON nodes, and writing the final document, forming the interface between dump/optinfo production and JSON-file emission.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface header for the optinfo-emit-json group: it declares optrecord_json_writer and its conversion/output methods. Unlike optinfo-emit-json.cc, which builds the JSON document and writes it, this header defines the bridge API used by dump/optinfo code.
